meta.name: mod-packer
meta.author: EBwilson
meta.description:
A mod packaging tool, a tool is added to the mod page to select the currently installed mod for packaging as a mod integration package for distribution. When using it, install the installer mod generated by the package directly, and it will guide the user to complete the installation.
====================
一个模组打包工具，在模组页面添加了一个工具，用于选择当前已安装的mod并打包为mod整合包以便分发，使用时直接安装打包生成的安装器mod，它会引导用户完成安装
